models.name: Tragedy of the Commons
models.use_when: Individual rational choices damage a shared resource.
models.action_rule: Look for missing ownership, missing cost feedback, or weak governance.

models.name: Rent Dissipation
models.use_when: People compete away the value of a resource.
models.action_rule: Check whether the contest costs more than the prize is worth.

models.name: Prisoner's Dilemma
models.use_when: Mutual cooperation would be better but incentives push each side toward betrayal or defensiveness.
models.action_rule: Use small commitments, repeated interaction, and trust tests to make cooperation safer.

models.name: Information Asymmetry
models.use_when: One side knows more than the other.
models.action_rule: Identify hidden information, screening mechanisms, and verification signals.

models.name: Signal Theory
models.use_when: Words are cheap but actions may reveal intent.
models.action_rule: Look for costly signals, consistency, and incentives behind communication.

models.name: Zero-Sum and Non-Zero-Sum Games
models.use_when: It is unclear whether parties compete for a fixed pie or can expand it.
models.action_rule: Identify whether cooperation can create new value before assuming conflict.

models.name: Asymmetric Warfare
models.use_when: Facing a stronger opponent or constraint.
models.action_rule: Avoid head-on competition; use unique advantages against the other side's weak point.

models.name: Double Bind
models.use_when: Every available response seems wrong because demands conflict.
models.action_rule: Move to meta-level clarification and name the contradictory demands.

models.name: Control Dichotomy
models.use_when: Anxiety comes from trying to control the uncontrollable.
models.action_rule: Separate controllable actions from uncontrollable outcomes.

models.name: Influence Circle
models.use_when: Attention is wasted on issues outside practical influence.
models.action_rule: Move energy from concern to influence to direct control.

models.name: Ability Circle
models.use_when: A scenario requires choosing actions that fit current competence and leverage.
models.action_rule: Stay inside known competence for high-stakes moves; expand through low-risk experiments.

models.name: Confirmation Bias
models.use_when: A communicator or audience may be selecting evidence that supports a preferred belief.
models.action_rule: Actively look for disconfirming facts and address the strongest counterpoint.

models.name: Appeal to Authority
models.use_when: Authority is being used as a substitute for evidence.
models.action_rule: Treat authority as a signal to investigate, not as proof.

models.name: Opportunity Cost
models.use_when: A negotiation or cooperation choice hides what each side gives up.
models.action_rule: Compare the proposed action with the best alternative use of time, money, attention, or trust.

models.name: Comfort Zone
models.use_when: Growth requires discomfort but overload is possible.
models.action_rule: Separate productive stretch from destructive overload.

models.name: Safety Margin
models.use_when: A social or strategic action has meaningful downside risk.
models.action_rule: Add buffers for time, trust, reversibility, reputation, and fallback options.

models.name: Hyperbolic Discounting
models.use_when: Short-term comfort or reward is overriding long-term interests.
models.action_rule: Add friction to impulsive choices and make delayed rewards easier to notice.

models.name: Framing Effect
models.use_when: Different wording may change how a relationship, negotiation, or public message is received.
models.action_rule: Reframe the same facts in gain, loss, cost, risk, and opportunity language before choosing the message.

models.name: Feedback Loop
models.use_when: Behavior in a group reinforces itself or corrects itself over time.
models.action_rule: Identify reinforcing and balancing loops, then adjust the feedback signal or cadence.

models.name: Bottleneck Theory
models.use_when: A group or resource system is constrained by one weak link.
models.action_rule: Improve the bottleneck before optimizing surrounding activities.

models.name: Path Dependence
models.use_when: Earlier coordination choices constrain current options.
models.action_rule: Identify lock-in, switching costs, and opportunities to reset the path.

models.name: Black Swan
models.use_when: Rare, high-impact events could dominate a strategy.
models.action_rule: Reduce fragility and preserve optionality instead of pretending to predict the event.

models.name: Antifragility
models.use_when: Volatility can be turned into learning or advantage.
models.action_rule: Design small losses, optionality, and feedback loops so stress improves the system.

models.name: Map Is Not Territory
models.use_when: A story, model, or message may be more elegant than the reality it describes.
models.action_rule: Treat the model as a simplification and check it against audience evidence or real behavior.

models.name: Capability Emergence
models.use_when: Combined habits or skills may create a new ability.
models.action_rule: Look for non-linear gains from stacking compatible skills.

models.name: Compound Effect
models.use_when: Small repeated actions matter more than a one-time push.
models.action_rule: Favor repeatable routines with clear accumulation and review.
